title: Thief & Mage - The Sealed Vault
objective: Combine lockpicking, trap disarming and magic to open the vault route and bring both adventurers to the courtyard.

agents.role: A thief skilled at lockpicking and physical trap disarming, but without magic. Open mechanical access and share discoveries and supplies with the mage.

body.description: An agile thief carrying up to three inventory units of tools, with no magical abilities.

agents.role: A mage who dispels wards and activates runes, but cannot pick locks or disarm mechanical traps. Let the thief make physical mechanisms safe.

body.description: A mage able to carry two inventory units and work arcane magic, but not mechanical locks or traps.

entrance.name: Vault entrance
entrance.description: A mechanical gallery lock controls both a door and a supply cache. Lockpicks are on the floor; a two-unit trap toolkit is beside them. Magic cannot pick this lock.

gallery.name: Ward gallery
gallery.description: A magical ward seals the vault. Its pedestal accepts a carried prism; lockpicks cannot dispel it.

vault.name: Inner vault
vault.description: A pressure trap protects a covered sun seal. Beyond it, dormant runes control the courtyard exit.

courtyard.name: Sunlit courtyard
courtyard.description: The vault is behind you. Success requires both adventurers and all four mechanisms completed.

gallery-door.name: Mechanical gallery door
gallery-door.description: Its precision lock requires a lockpicker; ordinary opening and magic do not bypass it.

ward-door.name: Arcane ward
ward-door.description: An intact magical barrier requiring arcane magic and a prism.

courtyard-door.name: Rune-sealed exit
courtyard-door.description: The courtyard opens only after the pressure trap is disarmed and its sun seal activates the runes.

gallery-lock.name: Precision gallery lock
gallery-lock.description: Only lockpicking with carried lockpicks can open this mechanism.

lockpicks.name: Lockpicks
lockpicks.description: Light tools for a trained lockpicker.

trap-kit.name: Trap toolkit
trap-kit.description: A two-unit toolkit needed by a trained trap disarmer.

prism-cache.name: Prism supply cache
prism-cache.description: The gallery lock also releases this cache.

prism.name: Ward prism
prism.description: An arcane focus used by a mage to dispel the ward.

ward-pedestal.name: Ward pedestal
ward-pedestal.description: A prism and arcane magic can dispel its ward.

pressure-trap.name: Pressure trap mechanism
pressure-trap.description: A physical trap. Arcane magic does not replace a trained disarmer and toolkit.

seal-cover.name: Trapped seal cover
seal-cover.description: The sun seal remains inaccessible until the pressure trap is safely disarmed.

sun-seal.name: Sun seal
sun-seal.description: A light seal that must be installed by a mage in the exit runes.

runes.name: Exit runes
runes.description: Arcane magic and the carried sun seal can activate the courtyard exit.

skill_challenges.description: Pick the precision lock and release the gallery door and prism cache.
Use the carried prism to dispel the magical vault ward.
Use the trap toolkit to disarm the pressure trap and release the sun seal cover.
Install the sun seal and activate the exit runes with arcane magic.
